findings.title: Error from json.Marshal ignored
findings.description: Both updateStatus() and postResult() use blank identifier to ignore json.Marshal errors. If marshaling fails, body will be nil/empty, resulting in malformed HTTP requests.
findings.fix: Check error from json.Marshal before proceeding. If error occurs, log and return early.
findings.impact: Silent failures in status updates or result posting. Coordinator won't receive job state changes.

findings.title: Response body not validated for errors
findings.description: Code only checks HTTP status code but doesn't read/validate response body for error details. If server returns error message in body, it's silently discarded.
findings.fix: After status code check, read response body and log error details if status indicates failure.
findings.impact: Loss of debugging information when API calls fail. Difficult to diagnose coordinator issues.

findings.title: Incomplete HTTP status code handling
findings.description: fetchPendingJobs() doesn't check resp.StatusCode at all. updateStatus() and postResult() only check for specific success codes (OK, Created). Other 4xx/5xx codes return generic error.
findings.fix: Treat all non-2xx responses as errors. Add status code to error message. Consider different handling for 4xx vs 5xx.
findings.impact: Cannot distinguish between client errors (4xx) and server errors (5xx) for proper retry logic.

findings.title: No validation of Job data
findings.description: Jobs fetched from coordinator are used without validation. If required fields are missing, code will panic when accessing them in process().
findings.fix: Add validation of required Job fields (ID, Name, SourcePath, DestPath) before processing.
findings.impact: Potential panic if coordinator returns malformed job data.
